title: Normalized ordinary adjunction of a fixed cochain scalar model
statement: Let J be a site satisfying the coefficient-universe sheafification and essential smallness assumptions, let R→S be a commutative ring sheaf map phi, and let D be a fixed derived change-of-rings cochain model for phi. There exists an ordinary adjunction between D.E and scalar restriction whose unit sends every section x to the transported sheafified pure tensor 1 tensor x. All universes and the cochain model remain fixed. Definitions and hypotheses are those of [def-weil-pbc-system-scalar-model] and [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings].

proof.text: Construct the normalized scalar package with this fixed model. Transport its ordinary adjunction through the model equality. Its normalized unit is one tensor the section; unfold the generic tensor generator and simplify one_smul. This is a generic proof in the fixed model, so concrete quotient systems are not unfolded.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarOrdinaryAdjunction
    {R S : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{sw}} (φ : R ⟶ S)
    (D : SheafOfModules.DerivedChangeOfRingsCochainModel φ) :
    ∃ adj : D.E ⊣ SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map φ),
      ∀ (N : SheafOfModules.{sw}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
        (x : N.val.obj U),
        (adj.unit.app N).val.app U x =
          (eqToHom (D.obj_eq N).symm).val.app U
            ((toSheafify J (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf φ N).presheaf).app U
              ((1 : S.obj.obj U) ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj U, (φ.hom.app U).hom] x))
